lines.t: In the courts of
consecration where the blood runs down the side where the fire never slumbers and the offering
must die i can hear your spirit calling from the inner holy place past the veil of fear and memory
into union face to face you're the ones for all atonement when before we sprinkled blood
now you beckon living bodies to the altar in the flood not with beast without a blemish
but with hearts laid bare and dry you invite us to the altar where the flame and love collide
So I lay myself down on the blood-sprinkled altar
Where the forerunner opened the way
First the Lamb upon the fire
Then the ones who follow after
Living offerings in His array
Every wound, every sin, every secret in my members
Every story burned into my frame
On this altar of my body, as a living sacrifice
Yahushua, heal me in Your flame
In the pattern of Leviticus
every part upon the fire hidden heart and hidden sinews all examined in the fire childhood vows
and no transgressions thoughts and glances touch and tongue all the stains in mind and body
that have marked me since i'm young you high priest within the heavens with your own blood
bearing in. Bid me bring my whole existence, taking ownership of sin. Not with coverings
and fragments, not with half of what I am, but in fullness on the altar for the love
So I lay myself down on the blood-sprinkled altar
Where your life was poured in love
You went first beyond the curtain
As the anchor and forerunner
Now your healing flows from above
Every wound, every sin, every memory I've hidden
And every scar that shapes my stride
Has a living, burning offer
On the altar of my body
You make wholeness where I die
This is priesthood in the spirit
Not the shadow but the truth
At the altar of my person
You do what the fire can do
You consume what must be ended
You refine what you would keep
Till the heart becomes a dwelling
For the Holy One who speaks
Burn away the flesh that hinders
Leave the fragrance you desire
Burn away the bruised defiance
Fill the temple with your fire
Burn away the early sorrows
Seal the cracks from old abuse
On this altar, Yahuwah
Let your mercy be the news
So we lay ourselves down on the blood-sprinkled altar
Where the pattern is complete
Law and shadow in Leviticus
Now fulfill that mercy seat
Every wound, every sin, every story in our members
We release into consuming flame
We draw near to the one who dwells between
The cherubim, Yahushua, Yahua
All for your name
From the altar through the curtain
We arise and you made certain
